name: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter
detailed_description:
Experience the Ultimate Multiplayer FPS Action on PC

Lock and load for adrenaline-pumping multiplayer FPS combat, now on Steam! Join intense PvP firefights, squad up with friends, and take control of the battlefield in a high-octane shooter designed for tactical warfare and fast-paced gunplay.

DOMINATE THE ARENA WITH CUSTOM LOADOUTS

Build your arsenal from a wide selection of powerful weapons—assault rifles, snipers, shotguns, pistols, and more. Customize every aspect of your loadout with unlockable attachments, skins, and gear to match your unique playstyle. Precision, reflexes, and strategy are your tools for survival.

TEAM UP OR GO SOLO – THE CHOICE IS YOURS

Whether you prefer working as a squad or going lone wolf, the choice is yours. Coordinate with your teammates via in-game voice chat, flank your enemies, and execute the perfect strategy to turn the tide of battle. Every match is a chance to outsmart and outgun your rivals.

COMPETE GLOBALLY – RISE THROUGH THE RANKS

Face off against players from around the world and prove your skills in ranked matches and seasonal tournaments. Climb the global leaderboards, earn prestigious ranks, and unlock exclusive rewards that showcase your dominance.

EVOLVING CONTENT & COMPETITIVE EVENTS

Stay sharp—new content is always on the horizon. Frequent updates bring fresh maps, game modes, seasonal challenges, and time-limited events to keep the action intense and the competition fierce. There’s always something new to master.

BATTLE ACROSS STUNNING, IMMERSIVE ENVIRONMENTS

Fight your way through a variety of detailed, atmospheric maps—from urban battlegrounds to abandoned wastelands. Dynamic weather systems and immersive sound design put you right in the heart of the conflict.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Fast-paced online multiplayer FPS combat

  • Deep weapon customization and progression

  • Competitive ranked play and leaderboards

  • Team-based gameplay with built-in voice comms

  • Stunning visuals and immersive environments

  • Frequent updates with new maps, modes, and gear

  • Global tournaments and seasonal events

short_description: Ready to prove yourself on the frontlines? Download now and join thousands of players in the ultimate test of skill, strategy, and firepower. Whether you're a casual sharpshooter or a hardcore tactician, there's a place for you on the battlefield. Lock. Load. Dominate.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Indonesian, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windos 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650 or Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Hazmob FPS is limited to realistic violence and blood/gore in a war-like multiplayer setting. There are constant gun battles and killing of enemy players, which is not suitable for children. However, players will not encounter any sexual content, nudity, drug use, or self-harm themes in this game.
